one view is declared six times: HostSceneViewSubmit -> SceneRenderRequest -> SceneViewportTask -> SceneViewRecording -> CameraFrameInput -> RenderViewOutputDesc

three idle mechanisms: renderFlags has no writer, sceneRevision is 0 and familyId is 1 so SceneViewFamilyKey collapses to snapshotIndex; seal() calls buildSnapshot() so ECS extraction is a side effect of grouping; the plan drops the Scene pointer so derivedSceneForHostView, SceneRenderPlanInput::complete() and derivedScenesAgreeWithPlan() exist only to look it back up
target: the owner declares its own views (ISceneViewProducer / collectSceneViews), the collector only groups, extraction is an explicit step, Renderer only records the plan

tests pin it: seal leaves empty entries, extraction runs once per unique Scene, an unresolved Scene drops its views while the rest still records
